sd_402043.description: A vertical, space-efficient storage solution designed for the fast-paced life of a campus Seedling. This sleek locker provides a secure, private compartment for personal gear, study materials, and extra rations, helping to keep communal living areas clutter-free.

sd_402044.name: Campus Locker Set
sd_402044.description: A high-capacity storage array designed for dorm hallways and communal campus hubs. This four-unit configuration allows multiple Seedlings to store their equipment in a centralized location, helping to maintain order and organization within the society.

sd_402046.name: Single Sanitary Unit
sd_402046.description: Designed specifically for high-humidity environments, the Single Sanitary Unit provides a sterile, ventilated space for Seedlings to store personal hygiene kits and clean attire. Its seamless, non-porous blue casing prevents the buildup of Avestan microbial spores, while the integrated sonic-cleaning vent at the top ensures that stored items remain fresh and contaminant-free. A must-have for maintaining high wellness and hygiene standards in communal campus washrooms.

sd_402047.name: Sanitary Units Set
sd_402047.description: An expanded hygiene management array designed for high-capacity washrooms and medical bays. This four-unit configuration provides localized, moisture-resistant stowage for an entire squad, ensuring that personal care items are kept organized and uncontaminated. Like the individual unit, this set features a seamless, non-porous exterior and internal sonic-cleaning vents, making it a critical asset for maintaining the health and morale of a densely populated campus.

sd_402048.name: Sanitary Bilateral Units Set
sd_402048.description: The Sanitary Bilateral Units Set is a high-density hygiene solution designed to act as a functional room divider in large-scale campus washrooms or locker rooms. Featuring biometric storage bays on both sides of the unit, it effectively doubles the available stowage capacity without increasing the floor footprint. Each of its eight compartments is equipped with the standard Sanitary-series sonic-cleaning vents and non-porous antimicrobial casing, allowing two different squads to manage their personal hygiene gear simultaneously from opposite sides.

sd_402050.name: Shelter Locker Unit
sd_402050.description: Built for the rigorous demands of frontier living, the Shelter Locker Unit provides a secure, impact-resistant space for a Seedling’s most essential gear. Its reinforced alloy frame is designed to withstand the harsh vibrations of society expansion, while the internal pressure-seal ensures that delicate electronics and personal mementos remain protected from the planet's fine silicate dust. A reliable staple for any growing settlement, ensuring that even in the most remote outposts, a Seedling's belongings have a safe home.

sd_402051.name: Shelter Locker Units Set
sd_402051.description: The primary gear-management solution for high-density frontier outposts. This four-bay configuration provides a centralized storage hub for your squad, combining individual security with rugged, space-saving architecture. Each compartment is reinforced with a pressure-sealed alloy door and a biometric sensor, protecting vital tools and personal items from the unpredictable elements of Avesta. Whether installed in a central habitat or a remote mining station, the Shelter Locker Set ensures your team stays organized and their equipment stays mission-ready.

sd_402036.name: Common-Link Modular Sofa
sd_402036.description: Designed for the communal heart of any habitat, this expansive corner sofa encourages Seedlings to gather, share stories, and build the social bonds essential for a thriving society. Its deep, moss-toned cushioning provides a restful retreat from the day's labor, while the open-front "U" configuration creates a natural focus point for group discussions or holographic entertainment. Durable, modular, and undeniably inviting.

sd_402037.name: Nexus Segmented Lounge
sd_402037.description: A premium upgrade to standard society seating, the Nexus features high-density segmented cushioning for superior lumbar support during long debriefs. Its expansive U-shaped design is specifically engineered to facilitate "cross-cluster" socialization, allowing multiple Seedling squads to relax together without feeling crowded.
